name: Lotus Eye Hospital & Institute Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1990, Lotus Eye Hospital 
and Institute Ltd provides ophthalmology and other related services.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
LEHIL is a listed Corporate Eye Hospital providing value-added super specialty services from its 8 Centers in Tamil Nadu and Kerala

cons: Stock is trading at 3.64 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 4.09% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 4.43% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.20 Cr.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -17.2%
